g: Grilling round 3 (2026-10-14): how Towns earn and pay, prices, controls

q: You said Towns pay the Crown when they buy or sell. Today the Tariff is new gold the Crown receives on top of each sale; no Town pays it. Who should pay the 30% instead?
ctx: This matters for balance: if Towns pay the Tariff out of their own gold, it stops being new money, and Tax becomes the only way gold enters the Kingdom.
o: The selling Town: it keeps 70% of the sale, the Crown gets 30%
The buying Town: it pays the price plus 30% on top

q: Residents pay their Town for the Goods it supplies them. How much per unit used?
ctx: Example with the first choice: a Hut's Peasants pay 1.5 × 4 = 6 gold for each Potato they eat. If the Town bought that Potato for 5 gold, it earns 1 gold; if it paid 8, it loses 2.
o: A fixed amount per Good: 1.5 × its base price for a Basic Need, 2 × for a Luxury. Market swings decide whether the Town makes a profit
The Good's current Kingdom price × 1.5 (Luxury × 2): Towns almost always profit
Keep today's model: Tax per resident per minute, higher when happier, unrelated to which Goods were used

q: "A Good's price is global, and each Town adjusts its own price on top." How does the global price move?
o: It doesn't: the global price is the Good's base price; only each Town's own adjustment (its Stock and Sales pressure) moves
It follows the whole Kingdom's supply and demand (lots of Stock everywhere = cheaper), and each Town adjusts on top

q: Buyers take whatever is available if they can afford it. When several Towns sell the same Good, which one does the buyer go to?
o: The nearest one that has enough (shortest trip)
The one with the most spare Stock (today's rule)

q: Keyboard shortcuts. Today: Space pause · 1 / 2 / 4 game speed · R research · K Castle · M mute · Esc cancel / close · Shift keeps the build tool · WASD or right-drag pan · mouse wheel zoom. Your rule takes 1-4 for the build tabs and 1-8 for buildings. A proposal for everything else:
ctx: Proposal: 1 Peasant · 2 Worker · 3 Burgher · 4 Aristocrat tabs; then 1-8 picks a building in the open tab · T found a Town · G road tool · X demolish · C Castle buildings tab · Space pause · + / - game speed (1×, 2×, 4×) · R research · K Castle · M mute · Esc close the tab or panel. The Kingdom Overview has a button only.
o: Change some (write them in the note)

q: Clicking a Good in the top-left list opens its details. What's in them? (Your earlier design: storage, net production, who makes and uses it, the price line.)
o: Kingdom Stock and where it sits (per Town), made and used per minute (net), the Towns that make it and the Towns that use it, and the price graph with 1 min / 5 min / 30 min / all time buttons showing % change. Opening it also turns on Resource Flow on the map
Only the price graph and the % change
